In a clinical trial with 140 participants, we showed that it measurably improves memory performance, everyday independence, and quality of life. More than 10,000 people already trust memodio.

We've been on the market for over five years. So we have the speed and ownership culture of a startup, without the chaotic early days: a validated product, paying reimbursement partners, and real users who notice when we ship something good. Now we're growing the engineering team.

Where you sit: anywhere in the world. We're a small distributed team, not a company with a remote policy bolted on. The one requirement is overlap: at least four hours of your working day between 09:00 and 18:00 Berlin time, because we solve problems together, not by throwing tickets over a wall.

How you join us: as an employee or as a freelancer, whichever fits your situation better. Tell us which you'd prefer when you apply.

Tasks

Our core product is live and helping thousands of people, but it's far from finished. A big part of this role is evolving the existing app to better fit the people who actually use it: adults aged 50+, often dealing with early-stage cognitive decline. Every improvement you make has a direct, visible effect on someone's day.

Beyond the core product we're building new and adjacent products, including ones with AI capabilities. If working with LLMs excites you, there's real room to shape that. If it doesn't, that's fine too.

How the role works

You won't get finished designs and implementation specs to execute. You'll get problems, context, and user needs and the freedom to figure out the best solution. That's deliberate: it's where the creativity and the ownership live. It also means the job asks you to think about what to build, not only how.

Today our CTO is hands-on in the codebase, supported by a part-time engineer. You'd join as the next full-time engineer on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.

Day to day

  • Frontend: evolve our Flutter app (iOS & Android), with a strong focus on good UX and usability for people aged 50+
  • Backend: design and build our Node.js APIs and services for new features
  • Product: work closely with our medical and product colleagues: your voice matters in what we build and how
  • Quality: help us keep code review, testing, and engineering standards at the level a regulated medical product demands
  • Optional: if DevOps interests you, there's room to shape our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and deployment but it isn't the core of the job

Requirements

What you bring

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, and we care far more about what you've actually shipped than about the number. Show us something you built
  • Flutter/Dart skills, or a proven ability to ramp up fast (e.g. coming from React Native or native mobile)
  • Working knowledge of Node.js and building APIs, you don't have to be equally strong on both ends, but you can't be mobile-only
  • You work well remotely and asynchronously. This is a distributed role on a tiny team. You write clearly, you post updates without being asked, you unblock yourself, and you don't go quiet for two days
  • At least four hours of daily overlap with 09:00–17:00 Berlin time (CET/CEST)
  • You're comfortable working from underspecified problems. As a small company we can't hand you full designs and implementation plans — you'll need to ask the right questions, propose solutions, and make calls. In return, you get creative freedom
  • A self-directed, structured way of working, you thrive with a lot of ownership and little supervision
  • Dedication: we don't do inhumane startup hours, but when it matters - a release, a deadline, a critical fix
  • Fluent English, written and spoken. German is a plus, not a requirement

Nice to have, not required

  • Interest or experience in software security, our product passed an intense security audit and we intend to keep that bar high
  • Experience with accessibility, or with building for older users
  • Experience with DiGA, medical devices, or other regulated environments
  • Startup or consultancy background
  • DevOps experience (CI/CD, cloud infrastructure)

You are probably not right if

  • You need a large team around you. For now it's you, a hands-on CTO, and a part-time engineer. Specialists to hand things off to come later, you'll help hire them
  • You're looking for greenfield-only work. A big part of this job is improving a live product with real users and real constraints
  • You need someone to hand you tickets, or a manager checking in daily. Remote and self-directed is the whole shape of this role
  • You see your scope as highly specialised. We need technical solutions for internal tooling here and there too. If touching a HubSpot integration feels beneath you, this isn't the right place

Benefits

What we offer

  • Purpose: your code measurably helps people — clinically proven, prescribed by doctors, reimbursed by statutory health insurance
  • Real ownership: as the next full-time engineer, you'll own features end to end and have a direct say in how we build
  • Stability with startup energy: 5+ years on the market, revenue from reimbursement partners
  • Genuinely remote, genuinely worldwide: work from wherever you're based, with flexible hours around a light overlap window. Our office in Potsdam is there if you ever want it
  • Your choice of setup: employment or freelance, whichever suits you
  • No office politics: a small, focused team where the energy goes into the product, not into positioning
  • Straight talk: you've just read our salary range and a list of reasons not to apply. That's how we operate internally too

If you have any questions, please don't hestitate to reach out :)
The initial phase will be a short questionnaire, followed by a small project and 1-2 live interview rounds.

title: (Senior) Revenue Operations Manager (all genders) (2)
description: Als (Senior) Revenue Operations Manager baust du das operative GTM-Rückgrat: HubSpot als zentrale Revenue-Plattform, automatisierte Sales-Prozesse und die Schnittstelle zwischen Produkt, Vertrieb, Marketing und Customer Success. Deine Aufgaben HubSpot-Ownership & Weiterentwicklung: HubSpot ist unsere zentrale Revenue-Plattform und du verantwortest alles, was dahinter liegt: Datenmodell, Custom Objects, Pipelines, Lifecycle Stages, Properties, Workflows und Dashboards. Du baust nicht auf der grünen Wiese, sondern verbesserst gezielt das, was schon steht – und erkennst, wo das Setup an seine Grenzen kommt. PLG und Sales-Assist verbinden: Kleine Betriebe schließen bei uns im Self-Service ab, ab einer bestimmten Größe begleitet Sales. Du baust die Brücke zwischen beiden Motions: ein PQL-Modell, das echtes Kaufinteresse sichtbar macht, saubere Übergänge in die persönliche Betreuung und ein Reporting, das beide Motions getrennt bewertet. Automatisierung & Integrationen: Du identifizierst manuelle Engpässe in Sales, CS und Support – Lead-Routing, Aufgaben, Handoffs, Benachrichtigungen – und automatisierst sie. Dazu gehören die Schnittstellen zu unserem Produkt, dem Data Warehouse und dem GTM-Stack: Custom Integrations über APIs, Reverse-ETL-Strecken und Automatisierungen in n8n. Revenue-Prozesse entlang des Customer Lifecycles: Von Lead-Capture über Scoring und Routing bis zum Übergang ins Sales-Team, und weiter über Onboarding, Adoption, Expansion und Renewal. Du denkst den Prozess über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg und stimmst ihn zwischen Marketing, Sales und CS ab. Verlässliche Daten, Reporting & Forecasting: Du sorgst für saubere, konsistente Daten und etablierst wiederkehrende Datenhygiene-Routinen. Darauf baust du Dashboards und KPIs, die als echte Steuerungsgrundlage taugen – damit sich die Führung auf den Forecast verlassen kann, statt ihn aus dem Bauch heraus zu korrigieren. KI im Revenue-Betrieb: Wir betreiben Teile unserer RevOps-Arbeit schon heute über KI: Claude mit MCP-Anbindung an HubSpot, n8n und unser Warehouse. Du treibst das weiter – wo ersetzt ein Agent einen manuellen Prozess, und wo braucht KI-Output eine Kontrolle, bevor er produktiv geht? Enablement & zentrale Anlaufstelle: Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für alle HubSpot- und Revenue-Operations-Fragen. Du dokumentierst, baust Playbooks, schulst das Team und sorgst dafür, dass die Systeme nicht nur existieren, sondern auch genutzt werden. Das bringst du mit Mind. 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Revenue/Sales Operations: Idealerweise in einem SaaS-Unternehmen mit wachsender GTM-Motion. Entscheidend ist nicht deine Erfahrung nach Anstellungsdauer, sondern dass du Prozesse im Gegensatz zum reinen Verwalten spürbar besser gemacht hast. Fundierte HubSpot-Expertise: Du kennst HubSpot nicht als Anwender, sondern als Gestalter: Datenmodell, Custom Objects und Associations, Pipelines, Workflows, Properties, Reporting. Du weißt, wo die native Plattform aufhört und wo du eigene Wege brauchst. Automatisierung, Integrationen & Prozessdesign: Du hast nachweisbar manuelle Abläufe automatisiert und Systeme über APIs verbunden. Webhooks, Custom Integrations und Automatisierungsplattformen wie n8n, Make oder Zapier gehören zu deinem Werkzeug – du weißt aber auch, wann native Bordmittel die bessere Antwort sind. Daten- & Analysekompetenz: Du erkennst Lücken in der Datenqualität, bevor sie zum Problem werden, und übersetzt Zahlen in klare Aussagen. Solides Verständnis von B2B-SaaS und GTM: Sales, Marketing, Customer Success und Support: Du verstehst die Mechanik, nicht nur die Begriffe. Du kannst einen Sales Cycle beschreiben, weißt, was einen Forecast belastbar macht, und erkennst, warum ein Prozess, der auf dem Papier funktioniert, im Alltag eines Sellers scheitert. Neugier für KI im Ops-Alltag: Du hast KI schon eingesetzt – HubSpots eigene Features, Claude oder ChatGPT für Analyse, Dokumentation und Datenaufbereitung, oder KI-Bausteine in n8n. Fünf Jahre Erfahrung erwartet hier niemand. Uns interessiert, was du selbst ausprobiert hast: MCP-Server, Agenten, kleine Tools am Abend, weil es dich interessiert. Hands-on-Mentalität & Eigenverantwortung: Du kommst gut damit zurecht, wenn es kein fertiges Playbook gibt, packst selbst an und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand sagt, wie es geht. Strukturiertes, klares Kommunikationsvermögen: Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch, schriftlich wie mündlich. Du holst unterschiedliche Stakeholder ab und bringst Abstimmungen zu einem Ergebnis statt ins Ping-Pong. Ein klares Plus, aber kein Muss: Du hast Product-Led Growth und Direct Sales schon einmal nebeneinander erlebt – PQLs, Self-Service-Konversion, Sales-Assist-Übergaben, Expansion aus Produktnutzung. Dazu: SQL, Erfahrung mit Produktdaten-Integrationen, HubSpot-Zertifizierungen (Sales/Marketing/Operations Hub). Unsere Benefits Unbefristete Festanstellung Home-Office Möglichkeit, flexible Arbeitszeiten Betriebliche Altersvorsorge Modernste Ausstattung (MacBook, Google) und höhenverstellbare Tische Strukuriertes Onboarding inkl. Gleichzeitig verändern sich die Erwartungen der Kunden: Behandlungen sollen professioneller, zugänglicher und selbstverständlicher werden. raw.title: Applied AI Engineer
raw.description:
About CHAPTERS Group

CHAPTERS Group AG is a Hamburg-based holding company investing in 55+ mission-critical software companies across the DACH region, France, and the Czech Republic. Our companies deliver the digital solutions that keep the public sector and core industries running. What they do matters in daily life.

AI has rapidly disrupted the software industry, and we aim to lead that transformation across our portfolio. Central to this is the AI Core team: we build and operate a shared enterprise AI Hub used by companies across the group, and drive adoption through a network of AI Champions. Each portfolio company has one designated power user who leads AI enablement locally, runs training, and scales usage within their organisation.

Tasks

The Role

You are part of the AI Core team but your work extends beyond it. Most of your time is spent embedded within one of our portfolio groups: responsible for deploying and operating the AI Hub for the companies within that group and integrating AI into their real business processes. Beyond this, you support the M&A team to develop AI driven use cases to support our acquisition strategy. You build production-grade systems, connect AI capabilities to existing infrastructure and make sure what gets deployed actually runs stably in the long term. You step in when complex AI use cases require real engineering work and changes to the companies cloud infrastructure.

What You Will Work On

  • Design and deploy production-grade AI solutions integrated into real operational systems: ERP, accounting tools, email inboxes, and legacy workflows
  • Build, test, and maintain integrations with enterprise services including MCP servers, Microsoft Graph, Git/Bitbucket, and REST APIs
  • You understand that shipping a solution is just the beginning. Your designs gather signals and feedback from operations for a continuous improvement cycle. Ensure AI systems run with full observability: logging, alerting, and audit trails that let non-technical stakeholders understand what is happening.
  • Work closely with AI Champions and portfolio group teams to translate business needs into implementable AI solutions and enable the Champions with your technical expertise to implement more use cases without your help in the future
  • Deploy, configure, and operate AI Hub instances (Open WebUI) for the portfolio companies within your assigned portfolio group: including onboarding, custom model setup, tool integrations, SSO, and ongoing maintenance
  • Support the M&A team to identify new targets, automate outreach and, support Due Diligence of new acquisition targets

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in a DevOps, backend engineering, or platform engineering role
  • Python fluency: you write clean, maintainable code and are comfortable owning a codebase
  • Practical experience with cloud infrastructure & production deployments on Azure, AWS, or GCP
  • Solid familiarity with Docker, REST APIs, Git, and CI/CD deployment workflows: including deploying and configuring containerised applications for end-customer environments
  • AI-native: you work with LLMs, know their limits, and have shipped something real using them
  • Strong communication skills: you translate technical decisions into business language and can work effectively with non-technical stakeholders
  • German (native or C2) and English (fluent): both are used daily across teams and OpCos

Bonus

  • Experience integrating AI into ERP, CRM, or accounting systems
  • Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks and tool-calling patterns
  • Infrastructure as Code experience (Bicep, Terraform, or CloudFormation)
  • Experience with enterprise authentication and identity (OAuth, SSO, Azure AD / Entra ID)
  • Prior experience working across multiple companies or in a group / holding structure

Benefits

What You'll Get

  • A dual role with real variety: strategic platform work at group level combined with hands-on implementation inside a Portfolio Platform
  • Become part of CHAPTERS Group, a German serial acquirer with 10x growth in the past five years and high ambitions for what comes next
  • A small, high-ownership team: decisions get made fast, your work ships to production. You are part of the CTO office with a direct line to the leadership team
  • Daily work with cutting-edge AI technologies
  • Space to define how AI gets integrated into operational business systems at group scale: early-stage work with lasting impact across 55+ companies
  • Permanent full-time position, remote-first with regular on-site time
  • A clear path to grow with us: we look for ambitious people who want to build a career, not just take a role. We actively invest in your development: talent reviews, events, conferences, etc.

How to Apply

Send your CV and answer the following questions, no formal cover letter needed:

  • Why do you find it exciting to work with vertical market software companies?
  • Why are you the right person to drive AI in the CHAPTERS Group? What is your “unfair advantage”?

We are looking forward to your application!

Experience with spatial audio technologies. Experience testing multi-channel audio systems or large-scale professional audio installations. raw.title: Software Engineer - Data (All Genders)
raw.description:
Hey!

Imagine amateur football finally had the platform it deserves.
Every weekend, millions of people write their own personal football stories – on pitches, in clubs and on the sidelines. We believe this passion deserves a digital home too.
That's exactly what we're building every single day.


Main information

  • Start: Immediately
  • Location: Cologne, Berlin London or Remote
  • Workload: Full-time
  • Team: Teamwear/Tech


Is this a match?

The most important basics – so we both know if it could work.

  • 100% remote: This role is generally available 100% remote within the EU or UK. If you'd still love to work from one of our offices in Cologne, Berlin or London - you're more than welcome.
  • Experience: You bring 6-8 years of experience in software engineering and data engineering.
  • Languages: You speak English fluently - German is a big plus.
  • Startup spirit: You'd rather shape things than just tick boxes - even when that means figuring stuff out without a finished roadmap.


Your playing field

Here's why this role matters for our mission.

  • Teamwear is one of our three company headlines, but technically it currently depends on one person.
  • As long as this remains the case, the area cannot scale beyond its current scope.
  • Your goal: To enable Teamwear to scale beyond its current scope.


How you'll make a difference

This is how you move our mission forward every day.

  • Data Pipelines: You build and maintain data pipelines for automated data collection, structured so that new sources and markets can be added quickly.
  • Algorithms: You develop algorithms to extract relevant information from websites and images.
  • Data Quality: You ensure data quality through validation, confidence levels, monitoring, and clean handovers internally and to partners.
  • Data Infrastructure: You manage and further develop the data infrastructure of the Teamwear area.
  • Technical Point of Contact: You act as the second technical point of contact for the Teamwear area.
In addition to your core responsibilities, you will also:
  • Internal Tools: You develop internal tools that enable the team to collect and correct data themselves.
  • Analytics & Reports: You create analytics and reports for internal stakeholders and external partners.


What you bring to the table

We're not looking for a perfect CV. But you should recognise yourself in these points.

  • Broad Technical Skillset: You move between data pipelines, backend and some frontend, and are not afraid of AI or image analysis.
  • Data Automation: You have experience with automated data pipelines, web scraping and image processing.
  • Databases & Data Modelling: You have expertise in databases and data modelling.
  • Independent Working: You work independently, even when there is no second engineer in the room and the context comes from business teams.
  • Fast Learner: You quickly get familiar with unfamiliar domains and ask the right questions along the way.
  • 80/20 Mindset: You know when fast and good enough is the right approach and when the data needs to be 100% accurate because a decision is based on it.
  • Data Quality: You care about details when it comes to data quality and make uncertainties explicit.
  • Data-Driven Thinking: You don't stop at analysing the data. You identify what is in the data, what it means and what we should look at next - even if nobody asked.
  • Engineering Practice: You write clean, maintainable code and follow good engineering practices such as testing and code reviews.
  • Tools: Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Grafana, Metabase, Pulumi, Kubernetes, AWS, LLM APIs
Good to know
We want you to know what this role really looks like from day one.
  • If you are looking for clearly defined tickets, a large engineering team and a finished tech stack, this role is probably not for you.
    • You will work largely as a team of two within Engineering. Most of your day-to-day work will be with business people, not engineers.
    • You have two connections: technically to Engineering and on the content side to the Teamwear team. This gives you a lot of freedom and means you need to set your own priorities.
    • A large part of the role is data collection and data quality, rather than greenfield ML. The exciting part is turning messy, real-world sources into reliable data.
    • The area is new. There is no finished setup for you to work with - you will help build it.
    • AI-first: We work AI-first, and AI tools are an active part of our workflow.


Bonus

Not a must - but this'll definitely earn you extra points.

  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes or IaC (Pulumi/Terraform). You can also learn this with us.
  • Experience presenting and preparing data for non-technical audiences.
  • A personal connection to amateur football.


Benefits

  • Be part of it from the start – Shape how Prematch grows and transforms amateur football.
  • Competitive salary – You’ll be paid fairly and transparently.
  • Employee participation (VSOP) - directly benefit from the company’s success.
  • Three cool offices in Cologne, Berlin, and London - true startup vibes to work and grow together. Want to visit another office? We support that too!

  • Remote, even from afar - Whether it’s a week of sunshine abroad or a few days with family - we allow flexible work from outside your usual location.
  • Team spirit - whether in the office or at home, we use cool tools and a virtual office to keep the team tightly connected.
  • Modern IT equipment - We provide the tools and devices you need to be productive.
  • 27 vacation days per year - For your rest and to recharge. Plus special arrangements if you’re a parent, so you can better balance family and relaxation.
  • Team events at our locations - Whether after work in Cologne, Berlin, or London: we regularly bring teams together to connect and grow stronger.
  • Offsites with the whole team - Four days out of the daily grind with the entire team: trips, brainstorming, onsite collaboration, and real team spirit.


Still here? Sounds like a pretty good match.

If you've made it this far, we hope we've managed to show you one thing: how we work, what we believe in and why this role at PREMATCH is something special.

Werden Sie Teil des Teams und schreiben Sie Ihre eigene Erfolgsgeschichte. Im Rahmen der Trainee-Ausbildung werden Sie Schritt für Schritt auf den Beruf des Financial Consultants vorbereitet. Von der Neukundengewinnung über die Beratung bis hin zur Erstellung individueller Finanzstrategien. Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit: Eine Aufgabe, mit der Sie finanzielle Bildung in die Bevölkerung bringen. Entwicklung und Karriere: Fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung sowie regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche. raw.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Commercial Systems and Intelligence
raw.description:
About the team:

The Commercial Systems and Intelligence squad is a newly formed team within SumUp's Acquisition Mission under the Run & Grow tribe. We sit at the intersection of data, backend engineering, and sales operations, building the infrastructure that powers how SumUp attributes merchant acquisition, calculates commissions, and understands the full lifecycle of every merchant.

Today, these processes are largely manual. We're here to change that, automating what's opaque, and building systems that sales representatives, leadership, and analysts can actually trust. You'll join at the very beginning, helping to shape how the squad works, the architecture it builds on, and the standards it holds itself to.

 

What you'll do:

  • Aggregating data from across the SumUp ecosystem to determine which acquisition channel or sales agent drove a merchant to take a valuable action (e.g. signing up, adopting a product)
  • Establishing data models, API contracts, and rule definitions that automate existing manual commission workflows for field and tele-sales agents, partnerships and merchant referrals
  • Build the Lifecycle Event Log in close collaboration with the Merchant Intelligence squad. A centralized store of curated merchant lifecycle events (signups, product usage, verification, purchases) used across attribution, recommendations, customer support and sales
  • Build internal backoffices and APIs for sales representatives and leaders to monitor commission and modify commission plans, manage portfolios and resolve disputes
  • Define and document API contracts, schemas, and integration patterns that other engineering teams can adopt confidently
  • Establish best practices for testing, observability, and incident response within a newly formed squad
  • Use AI and agentic coding tools deliberately, to scaffold services, write tests, explore unfamiliar code, and draft documentation while maintaining full accountability for what gets shipped

 

You'll be great for this role if you:

  • Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly
  • Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
  • Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case
  • Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns
  • Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable — fintech, payments, or similar domains
  • Have built services from scratch in greenfield, early-stage squads with limited prior context,  and are energized, not unsettled, by that challenge
  • Have experience with testing, observability, and incident response practices and treat them as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts
  • Are resourceful and adaptable, you take end-to-end ownership, do more with less, and adjust quickly as priorities shift
  • Can bridge technical and non-technical audiences, translating fuzzy problems into clear engineering work and explaining trade-offs to engineers and sales stakeholders alike
  • Are pragmatic, you know when good enough ships value and when something genuinely needs to be done properly
  • Have mentorship instincts, you raise the bar for the people around you, not just your own output

  • Implement and validate integrations with infrastructure and enterprise services such as MCP servers, Git/Bitbucket, Microsoft Graph, and data providers

Required

  • Practical experience using LLMs via API (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar)

  • Ability to read and work from technical documentation independently

raw.title: Business Development Manager (m/w/d)
raw.description:
Keleya ist ein frauengeführtes FemTech-Startup aus Berlin. Unsere Mission: Werdenen und frischgebackenen Eltern die digitale Unterstützung zu geben, die sie in Schwangerschaft, Geburt und Elternzeit wirklich brauchen.

Mit unserer App bündeln wir evidenzbasiertes Expertenwissen, persönliche Sprechstunden mit examinierten Hebammen sowie Video- und Live-Kurse an einem Ort. Das Ergebnis: Als einzige Plattform ihrer Art in Deutschland kooperieren wir bereits mit über 80 Krankenkassen, die die Kosten für unsere Nutzerinnen übernehmen. Seit 2017 haben wir so schon mehr als 1.000.000 Mütter durch die ersten zwei Lebensjahre ihres Babys begleitet.
Wir arbeiten datengetrieben, transparent und mit dem klaren Anspruch, gemeinsam als Team den Zugang zu Wissen in dieser besonderen Zeit durch eine Integration ins Gesundheitssystem für alle Frauen und Familien zu ermöglichen.

Aufgaben

Die Rolle

Du möchtest nach deinen ersten Berufsjahren mehr Verantwortung übernehmen, näher an einem Produkt arbeiten und mit deiner Arbeit sichtbare Wirkung erzielen?

Als Business Development Manager entwickelst du gemeinsam mit unseren Krankenkassenpartnern bestehende Partnerschaften strategisch weiter und sorgst dafür, dass unsere digitalen Gesundheitsangebote noch mehr Frauen und Familien erreichen (B2B2C).

Dabei verbindest du Relationship Management mit analytischem und wachstumsorientiertem Denken. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Partnern, Product Growth, Marketing und unserer Chief Revenue Officer zusammen und übernimmst früh Verantwortung für eigene Themen und Projekte.

Unser Ziel ist nicht einfach, Partnerschaften zu verwalten: Wir möchten sie gemeinsam mit unseren Krankenkassen weiterentwickeln, die Nutzung unserer Angebote erhöhen und keleya nachhaltig in deren Versorgungsangebot integrieren.

Wenn du nach deinen ersten Jahren im Startup, Scale-up, Consulting oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld den nächsten Entwicklungsschritt suchst und Lust hast, nicht nur Empfehlungen auszusprechen, sondern selbst umzusetzen, könnte diese Rolle sehr gut zu dir passen.

Deine Aufgaben bei keleya:

Als Business Development Manager übernimmst du Verantwortung für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren bestehenden Krankenkassenpartnern.

Dein Ziel: Aus starken Partnerschaften echte Nutzung und Wirkung machen. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern und internen Teams dafür, dass unsere Leistungen bei den Versicherten ankommen und unsere Kooperationen kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden.

Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und hands-on und bringst Themen aktiv voran.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehört:

  • Partner Betreuung: Du betreust bestehende Krankenkassenpartnerschaften eigenverantwortlich und entwickelst sie im direkten Austausch mit deinen Ansprechpartnern weiter.
  • Schnittstellen-Koordination: Du verstehst die Ziele und Bedürfnisse unserer Partner, bringst diese strukturiert ins Unternehmen und koordinierst die Umsetzung mit Product Growth, Marketing und weiteren internen Teams, sodass mehr Versicherte unsere Angebote kennenlernen und nutzen.
  • Performance & Data Analytics: Du analysierst regelmäßig Performance- und Nutzungsdaten, erstellst Reportings und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Partnerschaften ab.
  • Potenzialanalyse & Growth: Du identifizierst Potenziale innerhalb bestehender Kooperationen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern Maßnahmen, die Nutzung, Reichweite bei potenziellen keleya Nutzerinnen und wirtschaftlichen Erfolg erhöhen.
  • Stakeholder Management: Du koordinierst unterschiedliche interne und externe Stakeholder und sorgst dafür, dass gemeinsame Projekte strukturiert und zuverlässig umgesetzt werden.
  • Produktintegration: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst mit uns weiter, wie keleya langfristig noch stärker in die Versorgungsangebote unserer Krankenkassenpartner integriert werden kann.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • Ausbildung: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, zum Beispiel in BWL, Gesundheitsökonomie, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Public Health oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich – oder bringst eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit.
  • Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit und hast bereits in einem Umfeld gearbeitet, in dem du früh Verantwortung übernehmen, unterschiedliche Themen strukturieren und eigenständig Lösungen entwickeln musstest, zum Beispiel in einem Startup, Scale-up, Consulting oder einem vergleichbaren Unternehmen.
  • Branchen-Plus: Erfahrung im B2B-Partnership-Management, Digital Health, Gesundheitswesen oder in der Zusammenarbeit mit Krankenkassen ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du kommunizierst gerne mit professionellen und anspruchsvollen Stakeholdern und kannst Beziehungen vertrauensvoll, souverän und auf Augenhöhe aufbauen.
  • Struktur & Organisation: Du arbeitest sehr strukturiert und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Projekte, Partner und interne Stakeholder parallel zusammenkommen.
  • Eigeninitiative: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen, arbeitest zuverlässig und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jeder nächste Schritt vorgegeben wird.
  • Analytisches Denken: Du denkst analytisch, kannst Kennzahlen schnell einordnen und daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten.
  • Mindset & Mission: Du kannst dich mit unserer Mission identifizieren und hast Lust, dich intensiv mit Women's Health, Digital Health und dem deutschen Gesundheitswesen auseinanderzusetzen.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr sichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2) für die professionelle Kommunikation mit unseren Krankenkassenpartnern sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (C1).

Du musst heute noch kein*e Healthcare- oder Partnership-Expert*in sein. Wichtiger ist uns, dass du schnell lernst, hohe Ansprüche an deine eigene Arbeit hast und Lust darauf mitbringst, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Benefits

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Steile Lernkurve & C-Level-Einblick: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Chief Revenue Officer zusammen, bekommst unmittelbares Feedback und wirst früh in strategisch relevante Themen eingebunden.
  • Echte Verantwortung ab Tag 1: Du übernimmst eigene Partnerschaften, Projekte und Themen und kannst sichtbar beeinflussen, wie wir unsere Kooperationen weiterentwickeln.
  • Entwicklung statt Stillstand: Du baust Know-how in Partnership Management, Digital Health, B2B2C, kommerzieller Steuerung, Stakeholder Management und der Zusammenarbeit mit Krankenkassen auf.
  • Nähe zum Produkt: Du arbeitest eng mit Product Growth und Marketing zusammen und siehst unmittelbar, wie deine Arbeit unser Produkt und dessen Nutzung beeinflusst.
  • Purpose: Du arbeitest an digitalen Gesundheitslösungen, die Frauen und Familien rund um Schwangerschaft, Geburt und die erste Zeit mit Kind unterstützen.
  • Mentoring & Team Culture: Du erhältst persönliches Mentoring und arbeitest mit einem motivierten und diversen Team zusammen, das Wissen teilt und sich gegenseitig unterstützt.
  • Community: Gemeinsame Team-Frühstücke und feste Feiern über das Jahr verteilt sorgen für regelmäßigen Austausch im Team.
  • Work-Life & Perks: 30 Urlaubstage sowie eine Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft.

title: Senior Specialist, Employee Relations - EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Remote</strong></h2> <div><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.<br><br><span class="discussion-id-2f7cb4da-dab4-8068-a80f-001c50b2d808 suggestion-update notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.</span><br><br>We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.</span></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!</span></div></div><h2>What this job can offer you</h2> <p>As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. The vision of the Lifecycle team at Remote is not just about maintaining the gold standard in HR practices; it’s about elevating it, integrating cutting-edge technology solutions, and enriching customer experiences in over 80+ countries. On this team, your work directly influences our ability to sustain and extend our compliance coverage, continuously enhance our customer journeys, and significantly increase our operational capacity. You’re not just part of a team; you’re at the forefront of shaping the future of work, ensuring every interaction is fast, intuitive, and profoundly impactful. Dive into a role where your passion for innovation, commitment to excellence, and drive to make a global difference aligns with our mission to empower organizations worldwide to employ anyone, anywhere — compliantly.</p> <p>The Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations &amp; Transitions manages employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance and providing delightful customer service. Additionally, the specialist provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources when needed.</p> <p>As part of a larger employee Lifecycle team, the Specialist is also expected to contribute to process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.</p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <h3>Offboarding</h3> <ul> <li>Manage and resolve end-to-end employee exits across multiple international jurisdictions, prioritizing a superior offboarding experience for Remote's clients and their employees.</li> <li>Provide sound guidance and manage clients' requests on various HR matters, including but not limited to termination, resignation and transfer procedures, employment contracts, and redundancy processes, ensuring legal compliance and best practices.</li> <li>Lead and facilitate meetings with clients and external employees, including but not limited to workforce reduction consultation meetings, administrative hearings, negotiations in separations and settlements, providing guidance on terminations, and delivering termination outcomes.</li> <li>Influence and negotiate positive outcomes in complex terminations, balancing multiple stakeholders with competing interests.</li> <li>Liaise with and coordinate various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance in offboarding activities and audits, including but not limited to payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, and trade unions.</li> <li>Draft, tailor and administer all termination and supplementary documents with accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring employee records are maintained with strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality regulations.</li> <li>Process offboarding on Remote's internal HRIS platform, collaborating with various internal stakeholders, such as Customer Success, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Time and Attendance, amongst other verticals, to ensure all aspects of the employee exit are administered correctly and promptly.</li> <li>Be the subject-matter expert and respond to internal and external queries on all offboarding matters in conjunction with Lifecycle's internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Navigate clients through Remote's Employee Relations resources and guides, helping them understand applicable policies and processes.</li> <li>Conduct preliminary assessment of workplace concerns, identifying key facts and applicable local regulations.</li> <li>Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure appropriate handling of employee relations matters.</li> <li>Support clients in understanding progressive disciplinary approaches and documentation requirements.</li> <li>Monitor ongoing employee relations cases, ensuring timely follow-up and coordination with relevant stakeholders.</li> <li>Actively identify opportunities for and contribute to process improvements, automation, product development and overall customer and employee experience through the offboarding and employee relations processes.</li> </ul> <h2>Key Requirements and Charactristics</h2> <ul> <li>Experience as a HR Advisor or HR Business Partner, with generalist HR competencies and exposure across the employee lifecycle.</li> <li>Proven experience with a strong background in managing voluntary and involuntary exits (terminations) with care, sensitivity and legal compliance; and providing comprehensive HR support and guidance on employment laws and regulations, spanning various jurisdictions.</li> <li>Ability to interpret and apply industrial instruments, analyze complex HR issues, undertake research, provide practical solutions and effectively communicate recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders when operating in ambiguous and unfamiliar environments.</li> <li>Basic understanding of employee relations principles, progressive discipline approaches, and workplace investigation fundamentals.</li> <li>Excellent communication, influencing, conflict management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to confidently lead difficult conversations to a positive outcome, often where parties have conflicting interests, maintaining professionalism and strict confidentiality.</li> <li>Business-level (advanced) proficiency in written and spoken English, with additional languages considered a plus.</li> <li>Aptitude and appetite to innovate and optimize processes, continuously identifying and implementing opportunities for automation and championing best practices.</li> <li>Efficiency in operations, with an awareness of the importance of thorough record-keeping and data integrity.</li> <li>Tech-savvy, with the ability to successfully collaborate asynchronously on various tools, and adapt to new and evolving systems.</li> <li>Ability to work autonomously and cohesively in an international team in a fast-paced, asynchronous, remote environment with multiple priorities. Willingness to work flexible hours as needed.</li> <li>Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrates strong automation and AI capabilities and AI fluency.</strong></li> </ul> <h2>Practicals</h2> <ul> <li><strong>You'll report to: </strong>Manager Employee Lifecycle, Employee Relations &amp; Transitions</li> <li><strong>Team: </strong>Lifecycle, Employee Relations &amp; Transitions</li> <li><strong>Location</strong>: EMEA</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Application process</strong></h2> <ol> <li>Interview with recruiter</li> <li>Take Home Exercise</li> <li>Interview with future manager</li> <li>Interview with team members (no managers present)</li> <li>Interview with Senior Manager</li> <li>Bar Raiser</li> <li><a href="https://www.notion.so/Veremark-Remote-96e108c037b8423cbd4c3f07a1f9b38b?pvs=21">Prior employment verification check</a></li> </ol> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Remote's <a href="https://www.notion.so/remotecom/people-Total-Rewards-1945bce8d3924ece9421ba8630f57b0c">Total Rewards philosophy</a> is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair <span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id-1691622878">equity</span><span class="discussion-level-1 discussion-id-f2a82bc4-09e4-4a71-ad93-755b1d26a690 notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="3"> pay </span>along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.</p> <p>At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce.&nbsp; We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.<br><br>Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.<br><br><em data-stringify-type="italic">At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards &amp; People Enablement team on a case by case basis.</em></p></div><div class="title">The annual salary range for this full-time position is</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$46,500</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$104,650 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Benefits</strong></h2> <div class="p-rich_text_section"> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Our full benefits &amp; perks are explained in our handbook at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://remote.com/r/benefits" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://remote.com/r/benefits" data-sk="tooltip_parent">remote.com/r/benefits</a>. As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:</span></div> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-indent="0" data-border="0"> <li style="font-size: 12pt;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">work from anywhere</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">flexible paid time off</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">flexible working hours (we are&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://remote.com/async" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.notion.so/remotecom/Working-Async-at-Remote-80c01cd443ad4c77a8ceaef7c5fba5d0" data-sk="tooltip_parent">async</a>)</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">16 weeks paid parental leave</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">budget towards <a href="https://app.notion.com/p/remotecom/Benefits-Perks-1e48a5869c274f40910b76d405b92f63?source=copy_link#3accb4dadab48025b7a6dbc23bc47504" target="_blank">co-working spaces, learning and wellness</a> (including gym memberships)</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">mental health support services</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">stock options</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">home office budget &amp; IT equipment</span></li> </ul> </div> <h2><strong>How you’ll plan your day (and life)</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at <a href="https://remote.com/async" target="_blank">remote.com/async</a>.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your <strong>life-work balance</strong> is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If that sounds like something you want, apply now!</span></p> <h2><strong>How to apply</strong></h2> <ol> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong data-stringify-type="bold">We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.</strong></span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.</span></li> </ol> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. During your interviews and beyond, we ask &amp; encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.<br></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">At Remote, we embrace AI as a valuable tool while prioritizing human creativity and authenticity.&nbsp;We look forward to meeting candidates who balance innovation with genuine expertise and experience.&nbsp;To learn more about Remote's AI guidelines check see&nbsp;<a href="https://www.notion.so/remotecom/Guidelines-on-using-AI-when-applying-for-a-job-at-Remote-11ccb4dadab4805f80a7c73b6567bd8f" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.notion.so/remotecom/Guidelines-on-using-AI-when-applying-for-a-job-at-Remote-11ccb4dadab4805f80a7c73b6567bd8f&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1733927526443000&amp;usg=AOvVaw2sIVooKuyGfRra1PtGXreV">here</a>.&nbsp;</span><br><br><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><em>Please note we accept applications on an ongoing basis.&nbsp;</em></span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

As a Graphene Photonics Data Analyst, you will transform complex characterization data into reliable insights that guide device design, process development, and manufacturing decisions. You will own and evolve our analysis software and data infrastructure, develop new methods for emerging experiments, and help scale our analytical capabilities as we transition from R&D to high-volume production.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Own and continuously improve our characterization analysis software suite

  • Develop new analysis methods as experiments and measurement capabilities evolve

  • Build and maintain reliable, scalable data infrastructure

  • Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and traceability of analysis outputs

  • Turn raw measurement data into actionable insights for process and design decisions

  • Extract device parameters from measured data and benchmark results against physical and compact models

  • Perform statistical process and yield analyses to identify trends, correlations, and outliers across wafers and lots

  • Correlate characterization results with process parameters, closing the loop between measurement and process control

  • Integrate analysis outputs with fab MES and data systems to enable real-time process feedback

  • Define standardized analysis protocols and transition mature R&D code into robust, production-ready tools

  • Optimize analysis pipelines for throughput and scalability as we move toward high-volume production

Your Qualifications

  • An M.S. or PhD in Data Science, Physics, or another relevant technical discipline

  • At least two years of relevant industry or research experience; a related PhD project

  • Strong Python skills and a genuine passion for building high-quality software

  • A proven track record of designing, developing, and owning a software pipeline or technical project end-to-end

  • A solid foundation in device physics, including solid-state physics, semiconductor devices, and photonics

  • Experience with statistical analysis, model fitting, and parameter extraction

  • Experience with data visualization and tracking trends across wafers, lots, or manufacturing processes

  • The ability to work with laboratory or fab instrument interfaces

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

 

Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? Let’s connect!

title: Marketing Associate – Special Projects & Events
description: Marketing Associate – Special Projects & Events Festanstellung · Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ) Unsere Mission für dich Du baust den Kanal, über den trawa dem industriellen Mittelstand begegnet: mehr als 30 Messen, Kongresse und Roundtables im Jahr, von der fünftägigen Leitmesse bis zum Fachkongress auf sechs Quadratmetern. Du entscheidest mit, welche davon stattfinden, führst sie durch und stehst für das Ergebnis ein. Es bleibt nicht beim Stand. Du baust die Landingpage, bewirbst die Events in Paid und Content und schreibst den LinkedIn-Post zur Messewoche. In kurzer Zeit kennst du den kompletten Weg von der Standfläche bis zur Opportunity im CRM — eine Breite, die dir ein großes Marketingteam nicht bietet. Europas B2B-Sektor gibt jährlich über 200 Milliarden Euro für Energie aus. Die Zeit, diesen Markt zu dekarbonisieren und unsere Markenbekanntheit zu steigern, ist jetzt. Das Team Neben dir sitzen Content, Growth und Product Marketing — Events sind der Kanal, an dem alle drei zusammenlaufen. Gleichzeitig bist du näher an Sales als die meisten Marketingrollen. Auf jeder Messe stehen Seller mit am Stand, und der Wert eines Events entsteht erst, wenn aus Gesprächen Termine werden. Du stimmst dich laufend mit Sales, SDRs und Revenue Operations ab. Deine Aufgaben Du ownst den Eventkalender. Welche Messe, welches Format, welches Budget. Du planst das Jahr, rechnest jedes Event durch und sagst ab, wenn die Zahl nicht stimmt. Du baust den Auftritt. Standfläche, Standbau, Grafik, Technik, Logistik. Du verhandelst mit Messegesellschaften und Dienstleistern, hältst die Fristen ein und stehst vor Ort selbst am Stand. Du machst aus Standtagen Termine. Einladungskampagnen, Teilnehmerlisten, Matchmaking, Terminsetzung vorab. Danach: Lead-Erfassung, Nachfass und Übergabe an Sales entlang eines klaren SLA. Du misst deine eigene Arbeit. Landingpages, Formulare, HubSpot-Workflows, Lead-Tagging und Reporting baust du selbst — und berichtest MQLs, Pipeline und Signings je Event gegen Plan. Du bleibst nicht bei Events. Newsletter, LinkedIn, PR und eigene Formate gehören dazu, bis hin zu Guerilla-Experimenten wie Briefkampagnen oder OOH. Was funktioniert, wiederholen wir. Nach wem wir suchen Ein bis vier Jahre B2B-Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Events oder Messen, gern mit Bezug zum deutschen Mittelstand Du bist extrovertiert: Auf dem Stand gehst du auf Menschen zu, statt zu warten, bis jemand stehen bleibt. Viele Gespräche am Tag geben dir Energie Du behältst den Überblick, wenn ein Dutzend Dienstleister und mehrere Messen parallel laufen – und eskalierst rechtzeitig Du denkst kaufmännisch und bewertest ein Event an dem, was es an Pipeline bringt Du baust dir Landingpage, Formular und Reporting selbst Bias to Action: lieber schnell testen und messen als lange konzipieren Deutsch muttersprachlich, gutes Englisch Berlin oder Umzug dorthin, plus Reisebereitschaft in der Messesaison und einen Führerschein Deine ersten 90 Tage: Nach sechs Wochen: Onboarding Du hast trawas Geschäftsmodell, Produkt und Zielgruppe im Detail verstanden und alle relevanten Stakeholder in Marketing und Sales kennengelernt. Du hast das laufende Eventportfolio übernommen, kennst jeden offenen Punkt und jede Frist und hast die Abläufe dokumentiert. Du warst auf allen Messen vor Ort, die in dieser Zeit stattfanden, und hast konkrete Verbesserungen benannt und erste Verantwortung übernommen. Im dritten Monat: Ramp-up Du verantwortest eigene Key Results im neuen Planungszyklus und lässt dich an den erzielten Ergebnissen messen. Du hast die Planung für das kommende Halbjahr aufgesetzt, jedes Event durchgerechnet und einen Entscheidungsvorschlag vorgelegt. Ein wiederverwendbarer Ablauf steht: Vorlauf, Aktivierung, Lead-Erfassung, Nachfass — nachvollziehbar genug, dass jemand anderes ihn ausführen könnte.. Warum wir? Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft und treibe eigenverantwortlich Projekte voran, die echten Einfluss auf unsere Produkte, unsere Kund:innen und die Umwelt haben. Dein Impact: Jede Messe bringt uns mit Unternehmen zusammen, deren Energiekosten wir senken und deren Verbrauch wir dekarbonisieren. Gestaltungsspielraum: Das Event-Marketing bei trawa ist im Aufbau. Du erbst keine fertigen Strukturen, sondern etablierst sie. Flexibles Arbeiten: Dich erwartet ein schönes Büro in Berlin mit einer lebendigen Unternehmenskultur. Homeoffice und flexible Arbeitszeiten sind möglich, 30 Urlaubstage unterstützen deine Work-Life-Balance. Attraktive Benefits: Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erhältst du Essensgutscheine, eine Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft, reichlich kostenlose Snacks und ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget. Persönliche Entwicklung: Weiterbildungstage, ein jährliches L&D-Budget und Coaching-Sessions über Sparrks. Vielfalt und Inklusion: Bei uns sind alle willkommen. Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven Arbeitsplatz ein, der Vielfalt wertschätzt, und ermutigen Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft sowie körperlicher oder neurodiverser Vielfalt zur Bewerbung. Wenn du strategisch denkst, operativ stark bist und gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, dann bewirb dich jetzt! Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst: Wir sind offen für Persönlichkeiten mit Potenzial und Leidenschaft. Über uns Willkommen im trawa-Universum! Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, das grüne Versorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft von Grund auf aufzubauen. Wie machen wir das? Wir schaffen einen direkten Zugang zu erneuerbarer Energie für B2B-Industrieunternehmen. Wir entwickeln Software und Technologie, um die Volatilität des Energiemarktes zu bewältigen. Wir professionalisieren die Energiebeschaffung auf der Käuferseite. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

  • IT-Systeme und Netzwerke planen, aufbauen und am Laufen halten - damit alles rund läuft

  • Netzwerktechnologien anwenden und vertiefen sowie Hosting- und Cloud-Lösungen nutzen

title: Senior Salesforce Developer (m/f/d)
description: Your new team: Would you like to build Salesforce solutions that directly improve the experience of thousands of customers? At auxmoney, you will join a dynamic, cross functional team with a strong focus on customer satisfaction and a 360 degree view of the customer journey. You will work at the intersection of tech, product, and business, shaping scalable platform capabilities and reliable workflows that support one of Europe’s leading fintech platforms. What you can expect: Own end to end delivery: You architect, implement, and maintain high quality Salesforce solutions across Apex, Flows, LWC, and data models, and you take technical ownership from design to release. Build strong architectures: You apply clean architecture, testability, and performance best practices, and you raise the bar for maintainable code across the platform. Deliver great Salesforce UX: You design and optimize Lightning Web Components with strong performance, thoughtful interaction patterns, and a focus on usable, scalable experiences. Secure by design: You implement robust security and sharing concepts aligned with Salesforce’s security model, including profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and field level security. Integrate with confidence: You design and implement integrations via REST and SOAP, platform events, and connectors with resilient patterns, strong authentication, and thorough error handling. Optimize for scale: You build within Salesforce governor limits and enforce best practices for bulkification, caching, transaction management, and async processing. Raise engineering standards: You define and champion platform standards, coding conventions, code reviews, and design guidelines as a trusted technical authority. Mentor and multiply impact: You coach junior and mid level developers through pair programming, structured knowledge sharing, and pragmatic guidance that improves team output. Partner across stakeholders: You collaborate closely with Product, Data, and Operations to translate complex business needs into scalable technical designs and delivery plans. Test for trust: You set expectations for meaningful unit and integration testing, and you help the team maintain strong, reliable coverage that supports safe delivery. Keep the platform reliable: You strengthen observability and maintainability through documentation, architectural decision records, and practical knowledge sharing. Work setup: You will work remotely within Germany, with collaboration routines that keep delivery fast, aligned, and transparent. Your profile Seasoned Salesforce development: You bring extensive hands on Salesforce development experience (8+ years) in enterprise environments and a track record of delivering impact at scale. Technical leadership: You are advanced in Flows and highly proficient in Apex and OOP, and you confidently choose the right approach across Flow, Apex, and configuration. Strong LWC expertise: You have deep experience with Lightning Web Components, including lifecycle, reactivity, performance optimization, and UI and UX best practices. Security and compliance mindset: You understand Salesforce’s security and sharing model and design for least privilege from the start. Integration skills: You connect Salesforce to external systems via REST and SOAP, OAuth, and named or external credentials, and you select suitable integration patterns for complex scenarios. Built for scale: You consistently apply best practices in governor limits, bulkification, transactions, async processing, and error handling, and you help others do the same. Delivery discipline: You work fluently with Git and pull requests, and you have hands on experience with CI and CD for Salesforce, for example Salesforce DX and GitHub Actions. Clear communication: You communicate technical concepts clearly in English and collaborate effectively in cross functional teams. Nice to have: You bring German skills, Salesforce certifications such as PD I or PD II, Architect track progress, and experience with managed packages, platform events, and Data Loader or ETL. What we offer: Flexibility for Your Lifestyle: Enjoy family-friendly working hours and a generous home office policy, allowing you to stay agile and flexible in any situation. Ergonomic Work Environment: For your office days, we provide ergonomic workstations that offer you a comfortable and healthy workspace. Independent Work: With short decision-making paths, we enable you to work autonomously and actively contribute your ideas – we provide space for you to take on responsibility. Grow with Us: Unlock your potential with numerous opportunities for growth and development, along with an annual development budget to help you achieve your professional and personal goals. Team Spirit: Team spirit is important to us – we regularly host events and parties where fun is guaranteed. Mobility Your Way: Whether you prefer a train ticket or parking – we support your choice of preferred mobility. Stay Active: Keep fit with a discounted membership at Fitness First or Urban Sports Club, or use our in-house fitness room to stay active after work and enhance your work-life balance. Secure Your Future: Think about your future – we offer subsidies for company pension plans so you can plan long-term with us. Tailored Benefits: We consider your personal life situation – whether you're a parent or love to travel, we offer customized benefits to suit your lifestyle. Your perspective: You will shape how auxmoney builds and scales its Salesforce platform by owning end to end delivery and influencing technical standards. Your work will directly improve reliability, speed, and quality across customer facing and operational processes. You will grow your impact through mentoring and by helping define future architecture decisions. At auxmoney, we’re committed to equal opportunity and diversity. We especially welcome applications from parents, people with disabilities, and members of the LGBTQIA+ community. Please feel free to let us know if you’d like us to use gender-neutral pronouns, if you need barrier-free access to our office, or if you require more time during the application process. Wein, Pasta, Kamera läuft.

Wir sind Vinolisa - der Onlineshop für italienischen Genuss. Bei
uns findest Du über 300 italienische Weine und Spirituosen und eine
feine Auswahl italienischer Feinkost. Dahinter steht ein humorvoller,
italienischer Familienbetrieb mit starkem Zusammenhalt.

Was uns fehlt: jemand, der das auf Instagram
& Co. sichtbar macht - hinter der Kamera und im Schnitt. Vor der
Kamera steht vor allem unser Inhaber; Du machst daraus die Videos.
Deshalb suchen wir Dich als Content Creator auf Minijob-Basis -
überwiegend von zuhause, mit 1–2 Drehtagen pro Monat bei uns in
Delmenhorst.

Schau Dich gern vorher um: @vinolisa auf Instagram,
Facebook, Youtube und TikTok. Unsere Kanäle sind noch klein, genau deshalb
suchen wir Dich: Hier prägst Du wirklich etwas, statt den fertigen Feed
eines großen Accounts zu verwalten.

Aufgaben

  • Du drehst kurze Videos (Reels/Shorts) rund um Wein, Pasta, Antipasti und italienische Genusskultur an 1–2 Drehtagen pro Monat bei uns vor Ort. Vor der Kamera steht dabei vor allem unser Inhaber, Du führst Regie: Bildideen, Kamera, Ton und Anleitung
  • Du schneidest die Videos selbst (Premiere Pro, CapCut oder womit Du am liebsten arbeitest) - von zuhause, wann es Dir passt
  • Du planst und veröffentlichst 2–3 Posts pro Woche und hältst unseren Feed lebendig
  • Du beantwortest Kommentare und Nachrichten - freundlich, persönlich, mit Genuss-Faktor
  • Ab und zu baust Du eine einfache Grafik
  • Ideen entwickeln wir gemeinsam: Wir haben einen großen Themen- und Skript-Fundus als Startpunkt, Du bringst Dein Gespür für Trends und Formate ein

Qualifikation

  • Du erstellst selbst Content: eigener Instagram-/TikTok-Account oder Beispiel-Videos, die Du uns zeigen kannst (das ist uns wichtiger als jeder Lebenslauf)
  • Du kannst mit dem Smartphone filmen und schneiden. Hook, Untertitel, Schnitt sind für Dich keine Fremdwörter
  • Du schreibst sicheres, sympathisches Deutsch (Du vertrittst uns in Kommentaren und DMs)
  • Du bist Genussmensch: Essen und Wein interessieren Dich (mindestens 18 Jahre - wir machen Werbung für Wein)
  • Du wohnst in der Umgebung von Delmenhorst / Bremen / Oldenburg und kommst für Drehtage gut zu uns
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und zuverlässig - wir geben Dir Freiheit, kein Mikromanagement

Schön, aber kein Muss:

  • Erfahrung mit Photoshop, Meta Business Suite oder Planungstools wie Buffer
  • Du stehst auch selbst gern mal vor der Kamera - kein Muss, die Hauptperson in den Videos ist unser Inhaber
  • Italien-Liebe oder Italienisch-Kenntnisse

Benefits

  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung: Nur die Drehtage sind Termine, alles andere machst Du, wann Du willst
  • Kreative Freiheit und flache Hierarchien: direkter Draht zum Inhaber, keine Freigabe-Schleifen
  • Regelmäßige Weinverkostungen - Du sollst wissen, worüber Du Content machst
  • Mitarbeiterrabatt auf Wein und Feinkost
  • Kostenloser italienischer Barista-Kaffee bei uns vor Ort
  • Ein öffentliches Portfolio mit einer echten Marke: Deine Videos kannst Du überall vorzeigen

  1. Den Link zu Deinem Account oder 2–3 Beispiel-Videos von Dir
  2. 2–3 Sätze: Wer bist Du und warum hast Du Lust auf Wein & Feinkost?

title: Senior Account Manager
description: <h2>Opportunity</h2> <p>Brunswick Group’s Investor Brand practice is recruiting for a Senior Account Manager in London.</p> <p>We are looking for a confident and highly organised client manager who can independently run smaller engagements and substantial workstreams within larger programmes. You will build trusted day-to-day client relationships, keep complex work moving and support Account Directors and Partners on larger programmes.</p> <p>Investor Brand has three core engines: Financial Communications, Strategic Events and Corporate Brand. These are underpinned by our Film &amp; Live and Design capabilities. The work is varied, from results, M&amp;A and other significant investor moments to naming, rebrands, employee engagement campaigns, annual and ESG reporting, film, content and live experiences.</p> <p>The Senior Account Manager is part of our wider account management team. You will work directly on corporate brand and creative projects, while also supporting account teams across Financial Communications and Strategic Events. You will work closely with account colleagues, Partners, strategists, designers, producers and project managers. The role has no formal line-management responsibility.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:</p> <p><strong>Client and account management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Independently manage day-to-day client relationships on smaller engagements and defined workstreams, and support Account Directors and Partners on the largest programmes.</li> <li>Build a strong understanding of each client’s business, stakeholders and communications priorities.</li> <li>Turn client requests into clear briefs, actions and decisions, seeking senior input where the strategic or commercial judgement requires it.</li> <li>Plan and run client meetings, status calls and presentations, with accurate follow-up and dependable ownership of next steps.</li> <li>Coordinate feedback and approvals, manage expectations and raise risks or sensitive issues early.</li> <li>Work as an active member of the wider account management team, sharing client intelligence, actions and opportunities rather than operating as a separate project function.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Integrated brand and creative delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage projects and workstreams across Financial Communications, Strategic Events and Corporate Brand, with regular involvement in corporate brand and creative work.</li> <li>Work across assignments including naming, rebrands, employee engagement campaigns, annual and ESG reporting, results, M&amp;A, film and live events.</li> <li>Coordinate strategists, designers, writers, producers and other specialists so the team has a clear brief, timely inputs and shared priorities.</li> <li>Work closely with project management on scopes, schedules, budgets, resource plans, risks and dependencies, with clear ownership between the disciplines.</li> <li>Support discovery, stakeholder engagement, creative reviews, production and launch, keeping the client informed and the work connected.</li> <li>Maintain a high standard of quality control across briefs, presentations, status materials and client-ready deliverables, and keep multiple workstreams moving at pace.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Commercial development and growth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support and, where appropriate, lead proposals, pitch materials, credentials and chemistry meetings.</li> <li>Help develop clear scopes of work, fees and delivery approaches with Account Directors, Partners and project managers.</li> <li>Track scope, budget and resource use with the project management team, and flag changes or pressure points early.</li> <li>Identify follow-on needs and wider client opportunities, and raise them with the relevant account lead.</li> <li>Contribute to account plans, pipeline updates, case studies and practice-wide new business activity.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Collaboration and practice contribution</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build strong working relationships across account management, Investor Brand, Brunswick’s advisory teams and the wider global firm.</li> <li>Bring a practical, solutions-focused approach and communicate clearly when priorities, decisions or responsibilities are unclear.</li> <li>Share useful knowledge and support colleagues through project work, while continuing to develop your own strategic and commercial judgement.</li> <li>Contribute ideas and learning that improve our client experience, our offers and the way multidisciplinary teams work together.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <ul> <li>Strong experience in account or client management within a brand, design, creative or corporate communications agency or consultancy.</li> <li>A track record of independently managing projects or substantial workstreams from brief through delivery.</li> <li>Experience in corporate brand, identity or creative campaigns, with exposure to Employee Engagement, Annual &amp; ESG Reporting, film, content, investor communications or events an advantage.</li> <li>Confident and credible with clients, including the ability to listen well, ask good questions and communicate clear recommendations.</li> <li>Excellent organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of the wider objective.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, including briefs, proposals, status updates and presentations.</li> <li>Sound commercial awareness and experience working with scopes, budgets and change control.</li> <li>A good understanding of how strategy, design, content and production come together to deliver effective corporate communications.</li> <li>A collaborative, proactive and calm working style, with the confidence to raise issues early and ask for support when needed.</li> <li>Experience in a leading agency environment, or with listed and high-profile organisations, is desirable but not essential.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <p>Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h1>About Brunswick</h1> <p>Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.</p> <p>Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer. &nbsp;All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please&nbsp;read our <a href="https://www.brunswickgroup.com/app/uploads/Group-Privacy-Notice-for-Employees_April-2026.pdf" target="_blank">Global Privacy Notice</a> to understand how your data is managed.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
